# Dabba

> Dabba is a self hosted AI workspace. It brings 43 AI models from 8 providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, NVIDIA, Hugging Face, Ollama and more) into one chat, with agents, connectors, saved skills, projects and scheduled automations.

## What it does

- Chat with Claude, GPT, Gemini, NVIDIA Nemotron and local models, and set how much reasoning each reply gets.
- Cowork: describe a result, point Dabba at a project folder, and it works through the task and reports back.
- 60 connectors through MCP, including GitHub, Google Drive, Google Docs, Microsoft 365, Slack, Notion, Jira and Gmail.
- Saved skills (reusable instructions) and scheduled skills that run on a schedule with run history.
- Export answers to PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

## Hosting and data

- Free to run on your own server; you pay model providers directly for the API keys you add.
- One Docker image serves the app and the API, with ready setups for Render and Kubernetes (Helm).
- Accounts, chats and projects are stored on your own server. Provider keys stay on the server.
- The first account created on a server becomes its owner; features that run commands on the server are limited to the owner.
